purpose: Test whether paper-intended sentence boundaries can rescue a case where the released token-id delimiter implementation exposes only decimal-internal candidates.
paper_boundary_definition: A delimiter-token set D (e.g. commas and periods); the trigger acts only when the current token belongs to D.
boundary_detection: decoded_last-token suffix plus full generated-prefix validation, allowing fused tokens such as period-newline that the released token-id equality check misses
inference_boundary_rule: decoded comma/period/newline suffix, excluding numeric commas, numeric periods, blank lines, unclosed GSM8K calculator spans, and punctuation immediately following an unfinished arithmetic operator
depth_3_interpretation: checkpoint-native maximum of three inference invocations
depth_5_interpretation: diagnostic oracle with the same weights and inference limit temporarily raised from three to five
